sections.heading: What would you like to make?

children.text: A ring for yourself, a pair of wedding bands, an engagement ring or a gift? Send a sketch or reference photo. Rings are our workshop focus; ask us to assess other jewellery ideas individually.

Choose sterling silver or ask about a gold quote. If you are considering a Ceylon sapphire or another gem, tell us the colour, shape, size and budget you have in mind. We confirm suitable stones and documentation before purchase.

Share your travel dates, proposal or ceremony deadline. A simple band and a stone-set ring need different work. We confirm availability, making stages, cost and a realistic handover date before your booking.
In a guided ring-making workshop, you choose the details and work at the bench where the design and techniques allow. An artisan handles specialist steps for accuracy and safety.

For a more intricate piece, tell us what you want and when you need it. We can review feasibility and provide a tailored proposal. We do not promise off-the-shelf inventory, a specific gemstone or same-day completion without confirmation.

sections.heading: Can I make an engagement ring myself?

children.text: You can take part in a guided session. A plain band offers more hands-on possibilities than a delicate stone-set design. We will explain which stages an artisan must handle after reviewing your idea.

sections.heading: Can we make our wedding rings together?

children.text: Ask about a session for two, with your sizes, metals, designs and wedding date. We confirm whether both bands can be completed in the chosen session and what finishing may be needed.

sections.heading: Can I buy a Ceylon sapphire here?

children.text: Tell us the stone and ring you want. We can discuss sourcing a suitable gem for a design, subject to availability and review. Ask for the actual stone’s identity, known treatments, origin evidence, report and total price before committing; a Sri Lankan seller or cut does not by itself prove Sri Lankan origin.

sections.heading: Do you make gold rings or other jewellery?

children.text: Gold is quoted on request, with purity, weight and price discussed for the design. Rings are our hands-on specialty. We can review other custom jewellery requests individually and tell you if an artisan can take them on.

sections.heading: Can it be ready before my flight?

children.text: Tell us the exact travel date and your design first. A simple ring may fit a workshop visit; sourcing a stone, setting, engraving or specialist finishing can take longer. We confirm timing before you rely on a collection date.

sections.heading: How do I know the full cost?

children.text: Ask for a breakdown of workshop time, included metal, extra metal, gemstone, setting, engraving and any other work. We agree the scope and price before your session or custom order is confirmed.

sections.heading: Make your own ring in Sri Lanka: a guide to our Negombo workshop

children.text: Looking for a creative activity near Negombo? Here is how our guided ring-making experience works, what to think about before visiting and where to find the right workshop.

You start with an idea for a ring. An artisan helps you consider the shape, texture and details that suit the time and materials available for your chosen session. You take part in the making with guidance, then see the piece through its finishing stages. The amount of hands-on work depends on your design, the techniques involved and the workshop you select.
If doing as much of the work yourself matters to you, tell us before booking. We can talk through a suitable design and what will be possible in your session.
Yes. You do not need to arrive with jewellery-making skills. The session is guided step by step by a local artisan, so you can focus on choosing a design and learning how a ring comes together.
The

vary in length and scope. A simpler first ring needs less time than an intricate design or a session with stone setting. Compare the current inclusions on the offers page, then share your preferred date and design ideas. We will confirm availability, materials, gemstone options and any additional charges before you book.
Coming with a partner or friend? Let us know how many people will attend and whether you would each like to make a ring.

A ring-making workshop is an easy way to make a personal souvenir of your time in Sri Lanka. Leave enough room in your schedule for the session you choose, especially if you are travelling onward the same day. Send us your dates before making plans around the workshop; a booking request is confirmed only once we agree on a time.

sections.heading: Things to do in Negombo beyond the beach
sections.eyebrow: The local guide · Negombo, Sri Lanka

children.text: A morning at the fish market, time on the lagoon, a sunset by the sea—and a ring you make yourself. Here is a flexible way to enjoy Negombo on a short Sri Lanka stay.

sections.heading: A little sea, a little craft.

children.text: Use this as a loose sequence, not a timed tour. Check opening conditions locally and leave breathing room for travel, meals and weather.

Spend part of your visit at a workbench with a local artisan. Choose a shape and finish, take part in the making, and leave with a piece connected to your time in Sri Lanka. Materials, techniques and how much you do yourself depend on the workshop and design.
Negombo is a working fishing town. Visit the market when traders are active to see a part of everyday life, keeping out of working areas and asking before photographing people.
Consider a boat outing with a local operator, or enjoy the waterside at your own pace. Ask the operator about route, safety, timing and conditions before you set off.

sections.heading: Take a beach walk at sunset

children.text: The beach is a relaxed place to end the day. Conditions for swimming vary, so check locally and treat a walk and the evening light as the main event.
Look out for the canal, churches and traces of Negombo’s trading history. Dress and behave respectfully when visiting places of worship.
Make time for a seafood meal or a small local café. Ask about the catch and preparation on the day rather than planning around one fixed menu.

Negombo is a practical first or last stop on a Sri Lanka trip, but it is worth more than a night near the airport. Its working fishing community, lagoon, canal, beach and local craft give you a varied day without trying to do everything.
Visit the fish market if it is active, then explore the town and canal area respectfully.
Book a guided ring-making session. Confirm the date, design and time with us before arranging the rest of the day.
Walk by the beach around sunset or arrange a lagoon outing with a local operator. Finish with a meal nearby.

sections.heading: What can I do in Negombo on a rainy day?

children.text: A private jewellery workshop gives you a hands-on indoor activity. Ask us about availability and your preferred ring design; some steps and plans depend on the session and materials.

sections.heading: Can beginners or couples make rings?

children.text: Yes. An artisan guides beginners, solo visitors, friends and couples. If you want to do as much work yourself as possible, tell us before booking so we can suggest a suitable design.

sections.heading: Can I fit a workshop around a flight?

children.text: Possibly, but allow time for the whole session and travel. Share your flight or onward journey when enquiring. We will confirm whether a specific appointment works; a request alone does not reserve a place.

sections.heading: A beautiful stone deserves a clear story.

children.text: Sri Lanka is known for sapphires and other coloured gems. The Ring Experience can discuss gemstone ideas for a custom ring in Negombo. Ask us about a specific stone and design; availability, sourcing, origin evidence and setting work are confirmed individually.

It refers to sapphire attributed to Sri Lankan origin. A stone bought, cut or set here is not automatically mined here. For a valuable origin claim, ask for a report from an independent gem laboratory that states its opinion.

sections.heading: What should I ask before buying?

children.text: Request the identity, natural or laboratory-grown status, known treatments, measurements, price and any report for the exact stone. An origin opinion may not be possible for every gem. Keep the written details with your receipt.

sections.heading: Can it go into my ring?

children.text: The stone, cut, size, setting, chosen metal and available time all matter. An artisan may need to handle the setting. Send your ideas before booking so we can explain feasibility, involvement and cost.
Clear answers about silver, gold, gemstones, wedding and engagement rings, and making jewellery in Sri Lanka. Start with a question, then bring your ideas to the workbench.
Tell us when you will be in Negombo and what kind of ring you would like to make. We will help you choose a suitable session and confirm the details.
